name: Fecal Urgency
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by waiya
rules: COST – Choose a number for X that is less than or equal to the number of [G] you control. -- EFFECT – Draw X cards. Your faction loses X+X influence.
flavor: When you gotta go, you gotta go.
notes: Footer also has a decorative glyph/cipher string between artist and copyright (reads like '87...797754...//0'), not a rules field.

name: The Knitting Coalition
subtitle: (DOESN'T EXIST)
rules: This card cannot be used in tournament play. (But please, play with it for fun!) -- STARTING RESOURCES -- 2 Greed -- STARTING DRAW -- 3 going first, 4 going second -- HIDDEN INFLUENCE -- Your opponent ignores their faction's STARTING DRAW rule and uses this card's rule instead. -- DEVELOP RULE – PULLING STRINGS -- Your opponent ignores their faction's DEVELOP RULE. -- RESTORE RULE -- At the start of your turn, restore all your depleted cards and detach all resources from your faction. -- INFLATIONARY FORCES – DRAW -- COST – Both players may use this ability. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. -- INFLATIONARY FORCES – RESOURCE -- COST – Both players may use this ability. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Play a resource.
notes: Faction card: header banner reads 'THE KNITTING COALITION (DOESN'T EXIST)' then 'INFLUENCE – 28'; no type line. Footer shows only the SEED3 mark and 'EPIC', no collector number.

name: Elitism
notes: Resource card: full-art with 'ELITISM' on a side banner and the gearsmith icon in the top-right. No cost, type line, text, footer, artist, rarity or collector number printed.

name: Unscrupuls of Victory
subtitle: i don't think that's a word
rules: If you control at least [O][O], your opponent discards 1 card. If you control at least [G][G], draw 1 card. If you control at least [E][E], put 1 Micromajig token into play under your control. If you control at least [D][D], search your opponent's deck for 1 card and put it into their discard pile. If you control at least [R][R], you may pick a character. If you do, inflict 2 damage to it.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent discards' / 'your opponent's deck'; catalog says 'an opponent discards' / 'an opponent's deck'. Footer also has a decorative glyph string.

name: Community Chest
subtitle: original Open R&D game mechanic by waiya
rules: UNIQUE COMMUNITY CHEST -- At the start of each player's turn, both players may draw a card or play a resource. -- If you control at least [D] and choose to put this card on the bottom of your deck as part of your mulligan at the start of a game, you may reveal it. If you do, draw a card at the start of your turn.
notes: Card prints 'both players may draw a card or play a resource'; catalog says 'each player may ...'. Footer also has a decorative glyph string.
